basic_details.department: Civil Engineering; Mechanical Engineering; Electrical Engineering; Electronics & Communication Engg.; Computer Science & Engg; Aviation Engineering; Maritime Engineering
basic_details.short_information: Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya (GSV), a Central University under the Ministry of Railways, Government of India, has invited applications for 19 faculty positions in seven engineering domains: 6 Professor posts (Academic Pay Level-14, Rs 1,44,200-2,18,200) and 13 Associate Professor posts (Academic Pay Level-13A, Rs. 1,31,400-2,17,100). Applications are online only at https://gsv.ac.in/careers/, opening on 18 November 2026 and closing on 31 December 2026 (11:59 PM).

content_sections.heading: About the University
content_sections.text: Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya is a Central University established through an Act of Parliament in 2022, at Lalbaug, Vadodara, Gujarat. The notice describes it as India's first University focussed on transport and logistics related education, multidisciplinary research and training. It invites candidates with an excellent academic background for a wide range of faculty positions depending on qualifications, experience and specialisation.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice proposes to fill 19 positions: 6 Professor and 13 Associate Professor. OBC means OBC-NCL (Non-Creamy Layer). The notice says the number of positions may change at the time of selection, and the university reserves the right to consider good candidates over and above the number advertised. Civil Engineering: Structural Engineering (Bridge Engineering); Geo-Tech specialization in Tunnel Engineering; Transportation Engineering (Pavement Materials); Water Resource Engineering Mechanical Engineering: Mechatronics; Robotics; Solid Mechanics; Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC); CAD, CAM; Microelectromechanical Systems (MEMS) Electrical Engineering: High voltage engineering; Power systems; Power engineering; Switchgear and Protection; Power Electronics and Drives; Electrical Traction Computer Science & Engineering: Generative AI; Big Data Analytics; Network Design and Optimization; Computer Architecture; Software Engineering; Database Management Systems; Natural Language Processing Aviation: Aircraft Design and Structural Engineering; Aerodynamics Propulsion and Power Systems; Avionics and Control Systems; Flight Mechanics Electronics & Communication Engg.: VLSI & Embedded Systems; Semiconductor Fabrication; Communication Systems, Signal Processing; Microwave Engineering & Optical Communication Maritime Engineering: Naval Architecture; Ocean / Offshore Engineering; Marine & Systems Engineering; Ship Machinery, Ship Design / Building, Marine Power Plant

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be eligible for professional development allowance and initiation grant (seed grant) for research activities as per GSV Rules. The notice says reservation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS and Persons with Disabilities (PwBD) (VH, OH, HH) candidates applies as per Ministry of Education, Government of India rules, without any compromise on qualification, experience and competence.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice lists eight steps, ending in an offer of the position. Selection is based on interview, and only shortlisted candidates are told the date, time and mode of the interview. The shortlisting committee gives its recommendation on the suitability of candidates for the respective faculty position. Candidates recommended by the committee are called for a seminar and interaction. The seminar and interaction is held. Recommendation letters are sought from referees identified after the seminar and interaction. A final shortlist is made based on the application, faculty input, seminar, interaction and referee comments. Shortlisted candidates are called for a personal interview. The Selection Committee conducts the interview. Selected candidates are offered the position, as advertised, on approval of the competent authority. Merely meeting the eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be shortlisted. GSV may decide higher criteria or cut-off for shortlisting than the prescribed minimum.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GSV Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply through the link on the GSV website, https://gsv.ac.in/careers/ . The notice allows the online mode only. Apply between 18 November 2026 (application opens) and 31 December 2026, 11:59 PM (application closes). Keep ready the photo, signature and all documents for educational or technical qualifications, experience, publications and other details, in the format and size specified on the portal. If applying for more than one position or for positions in multiple disciplines, fill in a separate online application for each. Complete the form in all respects, including uploading all documents and paying the fee, by the closing time. The notice says this is the sole responsibility of the applicant. The fee is payable through the payment gateway by Internet banking, debit card, credit card or UPI, through the online application mode only. Government, semi-government or autonomous body employees should send the application through proper channel (a letter from the employer uploaded during the online application) or produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer at the time of the interview. For the NOC route, a declaration as per Proforma-A is submitted with the online application. Candidates in a private organisation, or on contract or temporary basis in a government, semi-government or autonomous organisation with no rule for issuing an NOC or forwarding applications, must upload a declaration as per Proforma-B with the online application. Proforma-A states that the original hard copy of the NOC will be submitted at the interview, and that an application may be rejected summarily and the candidate not allowed to appear in the interview if the NOC is not submitted. Outstation candidates called for interview may be reimbursed travel expenses from the place of residence in India to the place of interview (Vadodara) and back by the shortest route. This applies as per the instruction in the call letter, on production of tickets or invoice.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Photo and signature, in the format and size specified on the portal. Documents for educational or technical qualifications, experience details and publications. A valid certificate in the Central Government proforma, for candidates applying against a reserved post or claiming relaxation under SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS / PwBD. Employer's letter (proper channel) or Proforma-A declaration, for employees of government, semi-government or autonomous bodies. Proforma-B declaration, for private employees and contract or temporary employees with no NOC rule. With Proforma-A or Proforma-B: self-attested office order, memorandum or offer letter, latest salary slip (Oct. 2026, Nov. 2026 or Dec. 2026), employee ID card copy and a Government ID card copy (Aadhaar / PAN / Voter Card / Passport).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GSV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 19 vacancies: 6 for Professor and 13 for Associate Professor, across seven engineering domains. The notice says the number of positions may change at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GSV faculty posts?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 31 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Applications open on 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for GSV Professor and Associate Professor?
faq.answer: Both posts need a Ph.D. with first class or equivalent at the preceding degree in an appropriate branch, with a consistent and very good academic record. Professor needs at least fifteen Scopus indexed publications and Associate Professor at least 10.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GSV Professor and Associate Professor?
faq.answer: The limit is 50 years (preferable) for Professor and 45 years (preferable) for Associate Professor, as on the last date of online application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for GSV Professor and Associate Professor?
faq.answer: Professor is at academic pay level-14 (Rs 1,44,200-2,18,200) and Associate Professor at level-13A (Rs. 1,31,400-2,17,100) of the 7th CPC. Selected candidates will be eligible for professional development allowance and initiation grant as per GSV Rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GSV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UR, EWS and OBC-NCL applicants pay a non-refundable Rs. 2000/-. SC, ST, PwBD, women and transgender candidates pay no application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for GSV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only through the link on https://gsv.ac.in/careers/, between 18 November 2026 and 31 December 2026 (11:59 PM). Keep photo, signature and all supporting documents ready for upload.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GSV faculty posts?
faq.answer: Selection runs through shortlisting, a seminar and interaction, referee letters, a final shortlist and a personal interview by the Selection Committee. Only shortlisted candidates are told the date, time and mode of the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one discipline at GSV?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates applying for more than one position or discipline must fill in a separate online application for each.

faq.question: Q10. What should a government employee do while applying to GSV?
faq.answer: Send the application through proper channel, with the employer's letter uploaded online. Alternatively, upload the Proforma-A declaration and produce the employer's NOC at the interview.
